decision.reasoning_trace: The shopper evaluated a mix of high-end portable speakers, home-based audio systems, and mid-range options. While the feed was cluttered with accessories like cases and batteries (comprising about 25% of the results), several standout products remained visible. The JBL Charge 5 (prod_bluetooth_speakers_120) was selected as the final choice due to its high rating (4.8) and its balance of price, portability, and durability (IP67 rating). It outclassed the older Bose SoundLink Color II in performance specs and offered better utility than the stationary Edifier 2.1 system or the aesthetics-focused JBL Pulse 4.
